content: Abrahaames Yelettida Hara Nayta
Qasse Abrahaamey Keexura geetettiza hara machcho ekkides.
Iza Zimiraane, Yoqishaane, Medaane, Midiyaane, Yishibaaqenne Shuha izas yeladus.
Yoqishaaney Saabanne Dadaane yelides; Dadaaney Asooreta, Lexuusetanne Le7aameta yelides.
Midiyaane nayti Eefa, Efere, Heenooke, Abida7enne Elda7e. Hayti wurikka Keexura nayta.
Abrahaamey ba haaro ubbaa Yisaaqa laatissides.
Gido attiin izi buro paxa dishe ba garadetappe yelida naytas baas dizayssafe woytides. Woytidi ba naa Yisaaqappe istta shaakkidi arshey mokkiza baggara diza dere yeddides.
Abrahaame Hayqo
Abrahaamey mulera 175 layth de7ides.
Abrahaamey daro wode de7idi lo7o cima cimmidi hayqqides.
Iza nayti Yisaaqinne Isma7eeley iza Makipheele geetettiza gongolo duufon moogida; he gongolozi Mamire achchan Hiite Xoohaare naa Efroone gaden dees.
Hessika Abrahaamey Hiitetappe shammida gade. Abrahaamey ba machchiya Saaray moogettidason moogettides.
Abrahaamey hayqqidaappe guye Xoossi iza naa Yisaaqa anjjides. He wode Yisaaqi, «Tana Be7iza De7o Xoossaa Pultto» geetettiza pultto achchan dees.
Isma7eele Yeleta
Saara aylleya Gibxeppe yida Aggaara Abrahaames yelida naaza Isma7eele yeletay hayssafe kaalli xaafettidayssa.
Isma7eele nayti ba sunththaninne ba yeleta maaran haytantta; heytanttika Nebayoote, Qeedaare, Adibi7eele, Mibisaame,
Mishima7e, Duuma, Maase,
Hadaade, Teema, Yixure, Nafishaanenne Qeedima.
Isma7eele nayti haytantta; istta sunththi istta mooththaaninne dizason dizason hayssa; isttas 12 zarkke halaqati deettes.
Isma7eeley mulera 137 layth de7idi hayqqides; hayqqidi ba aawatan gaaggides.
Isma7eele zereththi Gibxeppe arshey mokkiza baggan diza Hawilappenne Shuurappe giddon Asoore efiza oge achchan de7ida. Istti ba ishata ubbatara morkketeththan de7ida.
Yisaaqa Yeleta
Abrahaame naa Yisaaqa yeletay hayssafe kaalli xaafettidayssa. Abrahaamey Yisaaqa yelides.
Yisaaqas layththay 40 gidida wode Irbiqa ekkides; iza Mesphexoomiyan diza Aaraame Baatu7eele nayonne Aaraame dere as Laaba michcho.
Yisaaqi ba machchiya maynne gidida gishshas izis GODAA woossiin GODAY iza woosaa siyides; histtiin iza machchiya Irbiqaykka qanththatadus.
Gido attiin izi ulo giddon diza nayti mentte gidida gishshas issoy issaara sugettida; histtiin iza, «Hayssi ta bolla ays hanizee?» gadus. Hessa gishshas Xoossaa oychchana biin,
GODAY izis, «Ne ulon nam7u kawoteththi dees; qasse ne ulon diza nam7u dere asati issoy issaafe shaakettana; issi dere asay hankkoytappe minnana; qasse bayray kaalozas haarettana» gides.
Izis yelo wodey gakkiin iza 2 attuma nayta mentte yeladus.
Koyro yelettidayssi aarissa; iza bollayka wuri iske xalla; hessa gishshas istti iza Eesawe
gi sunththida.
Hessafe guye, iza ishay yelettishe Eesawe toho oykki yelettides; hessa gishshas iza Yaaqoobe
gi sunththida. Irbiqay istta yelida wode, Yisaaqas layththay usuppun tammu layththi gidides.
Nayti diccida; Eesawey shankka eriza bazzo as gidides; gido attiin Yaaqoobey dunkaanen diza ashke as gidides.
Yisaaqi Eesawe siiqides; ays giikko izi shankkatidayssafe maanaas dosides; gido attiin Irbiqay Yaaqoobe siiqadus.
Issi wode Yaaqoobey woxe kaththishin Eesawe gafay wodhishin, bazzofe yides.
Eesawey Yaaqoobe, «Tana hayssa zo7o woxezappe miza; tana gafay wodhees» gides. (Hessa gishshas qasse iza sunththi Eedoome
geetettides.)
Yaaqoobey iza, «Koyro taas ne bayrateththaa bayza» gides.
Histtiin Eesawey, «Hekko! Ta hayqqana gays hanna ta bayrateththaya tana ay maaddanee?» gides.
Yaaqoobey zaaridi, «Ane taas koyro neni caaqqa» gides; hizgiin izi caaqqides; ba bayrateththaaka Yaaqoobes bayzides.
Hessafe simmiin Yaaqoobey Eesawes buddenanne misira woxe immiin izi midessinne uyides; hessafe guye dendidi bides; Eesawey ba bayrateththaa kadhides.

footnotes.text: Eesawe: Eesawe guussi Ibraaweta qaalara, «Iskama» guussa.
Yaaqoobe: Yaaqoobe guussi Ibraaweta qaalara, «Qirphe oykkizayssa» guussa.
Eedoome: Eedoome guussi Ibraaweta qaalara, «Zo7o» guussa.
